gloss: to use up completely; to exhaust; to consume entirely

definitions.gloss: to use up completely; to exhaust; to consume entirely
definitions.explanation: To use something until none of it is left. Applies to physical resources, money, energy, or time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{尽|つ}くした。
examples.english: I used up all my strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{尽|つ}くしてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up exhausting my savings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{尽|つ}くす⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should think of countermeasures before using up our limited resources.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use) + ⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ (to exhaust, to use up completely). Implies that the resource is now entirely gone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{尽|つ}くす: to use up all one's stamina
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{尽|つ}くす: to exhaust resources
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{尽|つ}くす: to spend the entire budget
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{尽|つ}くす: to give everything one has

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}る→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧: to use up — very close in meaning; ⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ emphasizes that nothing at all remains
- ⟦{消費|しょうひ}する→消費する：25230_shouhisuru⟧: to consume — neutral, does not imply total depletion
